metadata.title: समान नागरिक संहिता बनाम आदिवासी पहचान | UCC And Tribal Identity
metadata.description:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said country should now have universal civil code for equal rights of all citizens. After this statement a news debate on an old issue is started. Most of the people look at this debate from Hindu Muslim point of view, but this issue is equally sensitive for tribal community. we try to decipher how this issue can create an unrest in tribal areas of the country.

https://youtu.be/VlXTCXpAXbg
